Homelab 1.6.3 — First Release

Forked from an open-source Homelab client with the following additions:

New Features

- **New Home Dashboard** — redesigned with system health, Docker container, and qBittorrent cards, auto-refreshing every 10 seconds
- **OpenList support** — manage and play files from [OpenList](https://github.com/OpenListTeam/OpenList) (an open-source, multi-storage file list program), with playback powered by VLCKit supporting MKV/AVI and many more formats, offline caching, Picture-in-Picture, and external subtitles
- **CloudSaver support** — integrate [CloudSaver](https://github.com/jiangrui1994/CloudSaver) (an open-source netdisk resource search and transfer tool): poster search, one-tap transfer, auto-trigger plugins after finishing a title, and automatic re-login on JWT expiry
- **Arcane support** — manage your Docker containers from [Arcane](https://github.com/getarcaneapp/arcane) (an open-source Docker manager), including an interactive terminal (SwiftTerm), container images/statistics, and log viewing
- **Enhanced qBittorrent Details** — Tracker management and per-server rate limits
- **Intranet/Internet network mode switch** — one-tap switch between LAN and remote access

Requirements

- iOS 26.0 or later
- Install via AltStore Classic / SideStore

> **Android status**: The Android version is currently paused due to limited personal bandwidth — we are unable to maintain it for the time being. iOS remains the primary platform. The existing Android build (if any) stays as-is.
>
> **Note**: IPA is signed with a free Apple ID (development profile, expires 2026-08-12). Refresh via SideStore/AltStore after expiry.

---

Homelab 1.6.3 — 首个正式发布

本项目 fork 自开源 Homelab 客户端，在此基础上新增了以下功能：

新增功能

- **全新首页仪表盘** — 重新设计，包含系统健康、Docker 容器、qBittorrent 卡片，每 10 秒自动刷新
- **支持 OpenList** — 管理和播放 [OpenList](https://github.com/OpenListTeam/OpenList)（开源多存储网盘文件列表程序）中的文件，播放基于 VLCKit，支持 MKV/AVI 等多种格式、离线缓存、画中画与外挂字幕
- **支持 CloudSaver** — 集成 [CloudSaver](https://github.com/jiangrui1994/CloudSaver)（开源网盘资源搜索与转存工具）：海报搜索、一键转存、看完自动触发插件/运行，JWT 过期自动重新登录
- **支持 Arcane** — 通过 [Arcane](https://github.com/getarcaneapp/arcane)（开源 Docker 管理器）管理你的 Docker 容器，内置交互式终端（SwiftTerm），支持容器镜像/统计查看与日志浏览
- **qBittorrent 详情增强** — Tracker 管理与服务器级限速配置
- **内网/外网模式切换** — 局域网与远程访问一键切换

系统要求

- iOS 26.0 及以上
- 通过 AltStore Classic / SideStore 安装

> **Android 状态说明**：因个人精力有限，Android 版本暂时无力维护，已暂停开发。目前以 iOS 为主要平台，现有 Android 构建保持不变。
>
> **注意**：IPA 使用免费 Apple ID 签名（development profile，2026-08-12 到期），到期后请通过 SideStore/AltStore 刷新。
